title: yi plan checkpoint, format 2
description: The typed checkpoint of one plan journal, plan section 5.2. Written in the subset crates/runtime/src/schema.rs validates: type, required, properties, items, enum. Every other keyword here is descriptive and is ignored by the validator. A nullable field carries no type, because the subset has no union and its type check refuses null; the domain validator owns those. No required property carries a default.

format.description: 2, and only 2; anything else is refused after import

plan.description: the plan id, a slug; a sub-plan keeps its dotted parent prefix

goal.description: the goal text the plan was opened on

tier.description: root or sub; an unknown tag from a later version is kept verbatim, so this is not an enum

parent.description: present exactly when tier is sub: <plan>/<todo label>

spawns.description: the delegation fuse, monotonic; only a confirmed fuse reset lowers it

state.description: active, done, superseded, abandoned, or a tag a later version wrote

journal_seq.description: the seq of the last journal record this checkpoint reflects

intent.description: string or null: one paragraph the program or the owner wrote, at most 2 KiB

constraints.description: constraints the plan was opened under

examples.description: artifact or local references to example sets

shape.description: string or null: the shape that drove the plan, fork_join or scatter

state.description: pending, running, blocked, done, failed, abandoned, or a tag a later version wrote

attempt.description: attempts of this todo; a retry is a new attempt, and verdicts and tokens name it

refusals.description: refused transitions on this todo, capped

by.description: the agent running it; present exactly when state is running

blocked.description: present exactly when state is blocked

last.description: host minted at reap, never model supplied

note.description: prose imported from a format-1 body section, at most 4 KiB; a longer section is an artifact reference and is not inlined here

contract.description: what done verifies (plan section 6.1): class, items, threshold and min_coverage in permille

contract_hash.description: the contract's canonical digest frozen at start; a done that digests differently is drift

resolution.description: present when state is done: verified_done, accepted_by_user, accepted_by_classifier or legacy_unverified; absent on an uncontracted todo

intent.description: addresses of the owner's messages this todo serves (user://<n>); addresses only, never text

waived.description: owner messages this plan deliberately leaves unserved

ask.description: a question to the user: 3 to 5 options, the newest user message when it was asked (after), and the reply once one came (answer: its user:// address and the option it picked, the exemplar)

after.description: sibling labels this todo follows; ordering only

subplan.description: the sub-plan this todo decomposed into

delegation.description: execution and context only; acceptance moved to the contract in F0c

children.description: grouping only: a label and a state, no edges, no delegation, no sub-plan
